title: Heated Rivalry Season 2 Taps Percy Jackson & The Agency Stars for Fan-Favorite Roles
content:
Heated Rivalry Season 2 is adding stars from The Agency and Percy Jackson to its growing cast. Directed by Jacob Tierney, the two actors will play characters tied to Rachel Reid’s Game Changers novel on which the show is based.
